argv:
import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import harness_registry as H
import fleet_state as F
import jsonschema
assert F.choose(['not-gemini-4-argon-high'], 'argon') is None
assert F.choose(['not-gemini-4-argon-high', 'gemini-4-argon-high'], 'argon') == 'gemini-4-argon-high'
assert F.choose(['gemini-4-argon-high-fast'], 'argon') is None
assert F.choose(['gemini-4-argon-high-fast', 'gemini-4-argon-high'], 'argon') == 'gemini-4-argon-high'
assert F.choose(['gemini-4-argon-high'], 'argon') == 'gemini-4-argon-high'
assert F.choose(['gemini-4-argonx-high'], 'argon') is None
assert F.choose(['gpt-terra-10-high'], 'terra') == 'gpt-terra-10-high'
assert F.choose(['not-gpt-terra-1'], 'terra') is None
assert F.unlisted_models(['not-gemini-4-argon-high', 'gemini-4-argon-high', 'gemini-4-argon-high-fast'], ['argon']) == ['not-gemini-4-argon-high']
secrets = ['argon\n', 'sk-ant-api03-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', 'ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789', 'github_pat_shortkey', 'xoxb-short', 'AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE', 'a'*20, 'sk-ant']
reg = H.load_registry()
assert H.validate_registry(reg) is reg
for bad in secrets:
    assert H.FAMILY_RE.fullmatch(bad) is None, bad
    broken = copy.deepcopy(reg)
    broken['seat_specs']['agy.premium'] = ['agy', bad]
    try:
        H.validate_registry(broken)
    except H.RegistryError:
        pass
    else:
        raise SystemExit('accepted ' + bad)
for good in ('opus', 'fable', 'sol', 'grok', 'composer', 'terra', 'luna', 'argon', 'flash', 'sonnet', 'haiku'):
    assert H.FAMILY_RE.fullmatch(good), good
pat = json.load(open('schemas/fleet-inventory.schema.json'))['$defs']['family']['pattern']
assert pat.endswith('\\Z') and '$' not in pat and all(p in pat for p in ('sk-', 'ghp_', 'github_pat_', 'xox', 'AKIA'))
v = jsonschema.Draft202012Validator({'type': 'string', 'pattern': pat})
assert v.is_valid('argon') and v.is_valid('composer')
for bad in secrets:
    assert not v.is_valid(bad), bad
print('ok')
